frames.narration: Maria asks to delete her account. She signs in again and enters a code sent to her verified phone. The intake API creates request r-4821, due in 30 days, and soft-deletes the account: it is hidden, her sessions end and she has 3 days to cancel.
The grace period ends on day 3. The orchestrator asks the data map where user 77 has data. The map answers with 58 stores, and the orchestrator writes 58 tasks, all pending.
Before any hard delete the orchestrator asks the legal holds service. Nothing is held for user 77, so the tasks are released to the queue and the connectors.
The connectors delete her rows, search documents and cache keys in 56 stores. All of these tasks finish on the first try. The lake is next, and no rows are rewritten there.
For the lake, the connector deletes the key that encrypts user 77's fields. Her ciphertext stays in 41,000 files but nothing can decrypt it, and the task takes milliseconds.

The email vendor fails with an error. The connector retries after a minute, then after an hour, and on day 5 the vendor accepts the call and returns a deletion receipt. The orchestrator marks the last task done.

Each task wrote a signed entry to the proof ledger with the request id, a salted hash of her id, the store, the method and the time. The request completed on day 5, 25 days early. The ledger holds no personal data, and backups will have forgotten her after 35 days. Her id is on the replay list until then.
